tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List all VPS, dedicated, RDP or GPU plans with prices per location. RDP is only available in NL/RO/MD/RU. GPU is only available in IS/NL/RO/MD (Russia excluded due to NVIDIA export controls).

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List the 7 offshore jurisdictions ServGhost operates in, with privacy/legal features.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Calculate the final price (USD) for a plan + location + billing period, including discounts and any RAM / disk / extra-IP upgrades.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Deploy a server from your USD balance. BALANCE-ONLY: you must topup_create first (min $30, see topup_bonus for free credit tiers), wait for the topup to confirm, then call this. If your balance is short, returns {insufficient_balance: true, topup_required: true, deficit_usd, topup: {suggested_usd, s

tools.name: topup_create
tools.description: Top up your USD balance with crypto. Minimum $30, maximum $2000 per top-up. Bonus credit is applied automatically on confirmation: $100 → +$25, $250 → +$75, $500 → +$200, $1000 → +$500, $1500 → +$1000, $2000 → +$2000 (linear interpolation between anchors, no bonus below $100). Call topup_bonus first

tools.name: topup_bonus
tools.description: Return the bonus credit tiers applied to top-ups. Use this BEFORE topup_create so you can pick an amount that maximises free credit. No auth required.

tools.name: account_balance
tools.description: Return the current USD balance for an account. Use this to decide whether you can call create_order or need to topup_create first.

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a top-up (or legacy crypto-direct order). pending → confirmed (balance credited + bonus applied) for topups; pending → confirmed → active for legacy orders. After a topup confirms, call create_order to deploy.

tools.name: server_credentials
tools.description: Fetch IP, root password and console URL for a server, once status is active.

tools.name: server_action
tools.description: Send a lifecycle command to a server: reboot, shutdown, start, reinstall, or console_link.

tools.name: agent_help
tools.description: Return the canonical 4-call recipe for buying a server, with examples. Call this first if you are unsure how to use the tools.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "server_credentials" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Fetch IP, root password and console URL for a server, once status is active.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: server_credentials · Private data: create_order, topup_create, server_credentials · Public sink: topup_create, server_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: server_credentials · Private data: create_order, topup_create, server_credentials · Public sink: topup_create, server_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
